hint: fmt.Sprintf returns a string. For greet, handle the empty name before you format. For quoted, let %q do the escaping. For banner, the newlines are part of the format string.
Money stays in integer cents; convert to float only inside the format call.
Multiple assignment swaps values without a temporary variable.
Let iota number the bit flags; a typed constant keeps its type in every expression.
Pick the loop form that fits: counter, condition, or infinite with break.
An if can declare a short-lived variable before its condition.
A tagless switch is an else-if chain; fallthrough continues into the next case.
Arrays are values, so a function receives a copy of every element.
append may reuse a backing array; make and copy give you independence.
v, ok := m[key] tells a missing key apart from a stored zero.
Have totalWithTax call subtotal instead of repeating the multiplication.
Return the ok flag last, and check the divisor before dividing.
A slice spread with nums... behaves exactly like listing its elements.
Declare the captured variable inside the factory so each closure gets its own.
